## Summary

Closes #. What changed and why, in a few bullets.

## Evidence

- A test that fails before this change and passes after it.
- What else was run (the full suite, browser tests against the installed
  branch), and screenshots in light and dark for a UI change.
- Checked against [the review checklist](https://github.com/Athospd/targetsboard/blob/main/.github/REVIEW.md).

## Merge danger

- **Door:** one-way or two-way.
- **Blast radius:** what a mistake here would break.
